moments.title: The Hundred Finals Weekend
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament concludes its 2026 season with the men's and women's finals taking place at Lord's Cricket Ground on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Finals Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred! Who will be crowned champions at Lord's on Sunday? Get ready for a thrilling climax to the cricket season. #TheHundred

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: Did you follow Welsh Fire in The Hundred this year? The finals are this Sunday, wrapping up another action-packed season of 100-ball cricket!

angles.name: First Match Countdown
